description: Finds the agents waiting on the user and what each one asks.
name: triage
title: What needs me

arguments.description: The agent: its id from list_agents (like claude-w2:p9B) or its workspace name.
arguments.name: agent

description: Where one agent stands: its state, its folder and branch, and what its screen shows.
name: agent_status
title: One agent's status

arguments.description: The repository's path, as list_boards shows it. Leave it out to pick from list_boards.
arguments.name: repo

description: Which items on a repository's dispatch board are ready for review, and what each worker reports.
name: review_board
title: Review a dispatch board

arguments.description: The repository's path, as list_boards shows it.
arguments.name: repo

arguments.description: What to hand out, in the user's words. Leave it out to send what is already planned.
arguments.name: work

description: Plans work on a repository's dispatch board and sends it to workers, after the user agrees to the plan.
name: dispatch
title: Hand out work

arguments.description: How far back, like 30m, 12h or 2d. Default 12h.
arguments.name: since

description: A summary of what every agent did over a recent window.
name: daily_report
title: What the agents did
